title: Preserve JSON Patch operation serialization intent
goal: Serialize JSON Patch operations with the required from/value members, retain meaningful null values, and verify actual update outcomes before removing custom serialization rules.

selectionNotes: OperationType.Move/Copy replaces direct ShouldSerializeFrom calls. The latter has a default CS0618 warning in the current actual package.

Current from metadata omits null, not every irrelevant non-null source. Keep operation-aware normalization/modifiers if callers populate from on other operations. Value-holder metadata preserves required null values and omits irrelevant value members.
Both measured deserializers accept an omitted replace value as null; neither promises RFC member-presence validation. Add raw-JSON validation when that is your API contract.

Authenticate/authorize the record owner, allow-list path AND from, bound operation/body complexity, apply to a working copy and persist only on success. The loopback fixture is not a production authorization system.
Newtonsoft.Json patch is a separate unchanged package/serializer route. Do not transfer these attributes, warning or modifiers to that implementation.
